text:
Anna K: Heads up — seeing a spike in p95 decode latency on Ampere pools after yesterday's autotune push. appears tied to slen routing picks.
Mike L: ugh, saw alerts. any flamegraphs/telemetry?
Anna K: quick snapshot from perf infra: 
PerfBot: autotune/route-picker: p50=28ms p95=312ms p99=840ms (window=10m)
Anna K: baseline before change was p95 ~120ms. the regression started ~1745676000.
Sasha R: what changed in autotune? last PR adjusted the kernel cost model to prefer fused-kernel for mid-slen buckets.
Anna K: exactly. but telemetry shows many short-context requests (~<64) being routed into the mid-slen fused path during prefill, then falling back in decode which causes extra prefill work.
Jordan P: is this the prefill-vs-decode handoff we talked about? seems like mis-classification at request time.
Mike L: can you paste the decision log for a sample trace?
Anna K: pasted below (sanitized):
```
[trace id=abc123]
input_slen=22
route_decision: prefill_path=FUSED_MID (cost_est=11.2ms)
kernel_pick_time=43.8ms
kv_cache_hit=false
fallback_in_decode=true
```

Sasha R: kv_cache_hit=false is concerning — short ctxs should be hitting prefix cache. are we warming the KV on prefill?
Anna K: not always. autotune triggered fused kernel which skips the prefix warming in one codepath. results in cold KV at decode and a second kernel path hop.
Jordan P: so two problems: misrouted to fused-mid and the fused path not populating KV. combined cost blowup.
PerfBot: top callers contributing to regression: chat.complete (45%), summarizer (18%), reranker (10%) — sample size 48k reqs.
Mike L: rough mitigation: 1) tighten slen thresholds to avoid sending <64 to fused-mid, 2) ensure fused path writes KV warming entries, 3) add a short-circuit that forces prefill-only for requests with small input+history.
Sasha R: agree. I can revert the threshold tweak in autotune model to be more conservative and push a revision to the kernel-selection table.
Anna K: I pushed a quick canary: `rdwctl rollout revert route-model v1.12 -> v1.11 --canary=10%`
deploy-bot: rollback job queued: rollout.revert starting for route-model v1.12 -> v1.11 (canary 10%)
Anna K: also attached a profiler snapshot from an affected Ampere pod: 
```
kernel_fused_mid: total_time=312ms (kernel_exec=210ms + handoff=89ms + kv_miss_wait=13ms)
kernel_generic_short: total_time=34ms
```

Jordan P: is the handoff overhead constant across GPUs? maybe Ampere's kernel launch timings amplify cost. we should compare with A100 runs.
PerfBot: per-GPU breakdown: Ampere p95=312ms, A100 p95=140ms.
Mike L: that suggests kernel launch and occupancy differences. autotune should be architecture-aware: fused-mid is great on A100 but hurts on Ampere for short requests.
Sasha R: I'll add an architecture penalty term into the cost model (penalize fused on Ampere for slen<128). also adding a KV-warmup flag to fused path to force prefix caching.
Anna K: can we also run a targeted perf test with workloads skewed to short ctxs to validate?
Jordan P: I'll spin up a 50% short-ctx synthetic run against a canary pool and collect trace ids.
Mike L: thanks. after canary rollback we should see p95 drop back. if not, revert kernel-change too.
Anna K: timeline: revert rolled, canary telemetry in ~12m. will post updates.
Sasha R: PR for architecture penalty and kv-warmup flag incoming in 30m.
PerfBot: alert cleared? current p95=128ms (canary 12%): improving.
Anna K: good sign :thumbsup: we'll reconvene after full rollout telemetry.
Jordan P: add a regression test to the autotune harness that runs short-ctx workload on Ampere to catch this early.
Mike L: agreed — adding test now.
Anna K: thanks everyone. I'll file a short postmortem note if this stabilizes.
